01

Executive Summary

Northwind Analytics delivered a standout third quarter in FY2026, accelerating top-line expansion while materially improving operating leverage. Ending Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) reached $68.40M, representing 8.9% quarter-over-quarter growth (28.4% YoY), driven by strong enterprise adoption of our AI-assisted semantic modeling suite, Northwind Pulse, and disciplined multi-year renewal execution.

Quarterly recognized revenue rose to $16.65M (up from $15.20M in Q2), outperforming the midpoint of guidance by $420K. Net Revenue Retention (NRR) climbed 280 basis points to 115.2% on the strength of seat and compute-tier expansions within existing financial services and healthcare accounts, while Free Cash Flow margin expanded to 11.4% ($1.90M), keeping Northwind firmly ahead of its Rule-of-40 target.

Key Quarterly Wins

Commercial execution and product innovation combined in Q3 to unlock larger initial land deals, shorten enterprise security reviews, and expand Northwind’s partner-sourced pipeline.

Landmark Enterprise Deals Closed

Signed 19 net-new six-figure logos, led by a 3-year, $1.35M TCV agreement with Meridian Health Systems (4,200 seats) and a $480K ACV expansion with Vanguardia Financial.

Northwind Pulse AI GA Adoption

Achieved 38% paid attach rate across Q3 new enterprise bookings within 90 days of General Availability, lifting average new-logo ACV by 24% compared to Q2.

EU Sovereign Cloud & ISO 42001 Certification

Launched dedicated Frankfurt multi-tenant cluster and earned ISO/IEC 42001 AI governance certification, unblocking $2.9M in late-stage regulated EMEA pipeline.

Snowflake & Databricks Co-Sell Acceleration

Earned Premier Tier status in partner marketplaces; partner-influenced bookings grew 41% QoQ to represent 31% of total Q3 new ARR, reducing blended CAC payback to 14.8 months.

05

Risk Register & Severity Assessment

Leadership actively tracks operational, competitive, and macroeconomic risks entering Q4. Mitigation owners report bi-weekly against quantified leading indicators.

Risk Factor Severity Potential Business Impact Active Mitigation Plan
AI Inference Cost Volatility High Uncapped natural-language query bursts on Pulse AI could compress Non-GAAP gross margin by 150–220 bps as adoption scales. Deploying semantic query caching, routing routine prompts to distilled smaller models, and enforcing tiered compute credits on enterprise plans.
Enterprise Procurement Elongation High CISO AI-governance reviews in Fortune 1000 accounts are adding 18–25 days to Q4 late-stage close cycles ($4.6M pipeline exposed). Pre-packaging ISO 42001 + SOC 2 Type II trust bundles at Stage 2 discovery and offering mutual close plans with legal redline SLAs.
SMB & Lower Mid-Market Churn Medium Sub-$25K ACV cohort still exhibits 10.4% annualized logo churn due to IT budget consolidation among smaller tech customers. Launching automated in-product onboarding health scores, CSM pooled intervention playbooks, and annual-prepay renewal incentives.
Senior Solutions Architect Capacity Medium EMEA and APAC pre-sales engineering utilization reached 91% in September, risking technical POC bottlenecks in Q4. 4 senior SAs hired (starting Oct 2026) alongside partner-certified deployment accreditation across 6 regional SIs.
FX Headwinds (EUR / GBP / AUD) Low Currency fluctuations across growing non-USD billings (34% of new international contracts) could create minor reported revenue variance. Rolling 6-month natural expense matching in London/Frankfurt hubs plus Treasury forward hedging thresholds above $2M exposure.
